[KB-FAQ-022-s02-c01] Loyalty
## Loyalty **How do I move up a tier?** Tier is based on trailing 12-month merchandise spend: Bronze under $500, Silver $500, Gold $2,000, Platinum $5,000. Upgrades happen immediately when you cross a threshold. **Why did I get downgraded?** Your trailing 12-month spend fell below your tier's threshold. Downgrades are evaluated monthly, move you down only one tier at a time, and we email you 30 days beforehand. If you have held Gold or Platinum for 24 months or more, you get one automatic downgrade protection per 24-month period. **Do returns affect my tier?** Yes. A refund reduces your trailing spend and can trigger a downgrade. **When do my points expire?** 18 months after your most recent qualifying purchase — not 18 months after you earned them. Any purchase resets the clock on your whole balance. We warn you at 60 days and again at 14 days. **What are my points worth?** 100 points equals $5. Redeem in increments of 100. **Can I combine a promo code with points?** Usually yes. You cannot combine two targeted offers with each other. **My offer expired.
